question: Should this stay as the canonical dashboard-widget task after the modular dashboard foundation and gateway activity contract land, or should it be folded into a broader canonical issue?
rationale: The request is coherent and useful, but current main lacks the dashboard plugin foundation and the durable activity/attention API that would define the implementation boundary.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard-widget task
options.body: Keep this issue open as the specific presentation-layer task, sequenced after the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and gateway activity contract are accepted.

options.title: Fold into activity contract
options.body: Make the per-session activity-state issue own the remaining semantics and narrow this issue later to UI rendering only.

options.title: Defer bundled builtins
options.body: If maintainers do not want bundled dashboard widgets, redirect this to an external plugin path once the widget SDK is available.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard-widget task
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the specific presentation-layer task, sequenced after the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and gateway activity contract are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current-main routing signal across the session API/status code and the assigned prerequisite activity-contract issue.
